assets.title_fa: وحشتِ تالارِ دو سایه — بازطراحیِ آیکونیکِ رتیلِ هور (فصل ۶)
assets.prompt: Terrifying AAA survival-horror concept art, 16:9, Resident Evil 2/4 Remake RE Engine lighting inside pitch-black wet black-salt subterranean depths of Tang-e Hoor canyon. Over-the-shoulder foreground: Daniyal aiming a pump-action shotgun with weapon flashlight upward at a massive stone pillar while a burning crimson emergency road flare lies on wet black salt rock. Clinging to the pillar above is an original geological body-horror creature (Retil of Hoor): an emaciated, elongated hunched human figure in tattered salt-crusted industrial worker coveralls with a faded cloth wristband reading 1; the upper half of its face and eyes are completely sealed shut by jagged black-grey salt crystals, lower jaw agape. Not a spider, not a generic zombie. Chilling volumetric spore mist, crimson flare light, zero text.
